identity.title: [v0.92][WP-13][defect] Anchor cognitive-profile authority and verify full revision lineage

values.task_boundary: Implement and merge only the blocking WP-13 trusted-authority, full-lineage, and rotation repair with focused evidence; closeout bookkeeping remains asynchronous.
deliverables: adl-runtime-kernel/src/cognitive_profile.rs trusted authority, full-chain, and rotation contract
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Profile creation and update require a signed statement from a provisioned cognitive authority binding exact canonical policy and evidence digests.
AC-2: Caller-invented keys, policy, evidence, authority identifiers, epochs, or signatures fail closed without leaking untrusted values.
AC-3: Every predecessor through genesis is recomputed and verified for canonical input, profile, public projection, authority context, and exact predecessor linkage.
AC-4: Truncated, substituted, syntactically valid rehashed, or deep forged revision chains fail closed.
AC-5: Authority rotation requires a signed transition from the trusted current context to a new key/context with a strictly monotonic epoch.
AC-6: Stale, wrong-key, discontinuous, replayed, or self-signed rotation fails closed and does not rewrite older history.
AC-7: Existing privacy, nonclaim, evidence-category, projection, and deterministic replay boundaries remain intact.
AC-8: Exact nonzero focused tests, strict Clippy, formatting, native Linux/macOS receipts, semantic equivalence, typed validation, and independent exact-head review pass.
AC-9: A ready PR with Closes #144 merges before legacy issue #5831 is rebased or published.

Current origin/main Runtime v3 cognitive_profile, governance, identity, and continuity authority

non_goals: Broad Runtime v3 governance or identity redesign
